0xed300 execve("/bin/sh", ebp-0x28, [ebp-0x30])
constraints:
  address ebp-0x24 is writable
  edi is the GOT address of libc
  eax == NULL || {"/bin/sh", eax, NULL} is a valid argv
  [[ebp-0x30]] == NULL || [ebp-0x30] == NULL || [ebp-0x30] is a valid envp

constraints:
  esi is the GOT address of libc
  eax == NULL

0x18a496 execl("/bin/sh", [esp])
